name: io.github.udondan/fritz
title: FRITZ!Box (unofficial)
description: Reads the status and settings of a FRITZ!Box router over TR-064. Never changes anything.

environmentVariables.name: FRITZ_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Address of the FRITZ!Box, like 192.168.178.1 (HTTPS on port 49443) or http://192.168.178.1:49000. Defaults to fritz.box.

environmentVariables.name: FRITZ_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: User on the FRITZ!Box. Leave it out for devices with only a password.

environmentVariables.name: FRITZ_TLS_FINGERPRINT
environmentVariables.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of the certificate of the box, from `fritz tls fingerprint`. Needed for HTTPS, the default.

environmentVariables.name: FRITZ_MCP_PERSONAL
environmentVariables.description: true also serves calls, phonebooks and the event log, which are personal.
